trigger: many keys simultaneously in pending_initial (mass rule push, or many keys erroring at once)

Pre-existing scheduler characteristic (this PR adds no new fanout mechanism) made newly load-bearing by 6c depending on sweep cadence for demotion timeliness. Chaos: attach O(1000+) rules across distinct keys, force Unknown, measure per-key Convergence-eval interval vs configured cadence.
